- Acts by blocking the biosynthesis of ergosterol, the primary sterol derivative of the fungal cell membrane.
- Fights dandruff  and controls flaking, scaling, and itching of the scalp caused by dandruff

description:
Did you know 7 in 10 Indians struggle with dandruff - especially in winters? It’s more than just flakes. Persistent dandruff can leave your scalp itchy, inflamed, and even prone to infections, and may trigger hair fall.

Experience the transformation with Be Bodywise 1% Ketoconazole Shampoo

•Clinical blend of
➡️1% Ketoconazole: proven antifungal action
➡️3% PQ-7: conditioning agent for preventing frizz
➡️Aloe Vera: for fighting scalp inflammation

•Dermatologist-recommended active for tackling dandruff at its source

Results you can expect:

Month 1: Relief from itchiness & visible flaking
Month 2: Reduced fungal growth & scalp inflammation
Month 3: Long-lasting control of dandruff with regular use

Step 1: Wet your hair thoroughly with water.
Step 2: Take a sufficient amount of Be Bodywise 1% Ketoconazole Shampoo in your palm and apply directly to the scalp.
Step 3: Gently massage into your scalp. Leave for 1–2 minutes before rinsing well.

faqs.question: Do I need an expert prescription for Ketoconazole Shampoo?
faqs.answer: No, 1% ketoconazole shampoo is not an Rx product. You do not require a prescription for it and can get the shampoo by placing an order with us.

faqs.question: How long must I use this Anti Fungal Shampoo for dandruff to see results?
faqs.answer: You will notice visible reduction in dandruff after 2-3 washes. Use this Ketoconazole Anti Dandruff Shampoo for at least 12 weeks to stop dandruff completely. This shampoo has ketoconazole to help you stop the growth of dandruff immediately.

faqs.question: What are the side effects of this Ketoconazole Shampoo for Dandruff?
faqs.answer: There are no side effects. However, if you face excessive dryness or irritation in your scalp due to the ketoconazole in the shampoo, consult your expert at the earliest.

faqs.question: What else can I use with this Dandruff Shampoo for women? Will it make my hair too dry?
faqs.answer: Ketoconazole has slight drying properties. You can use Bodywise's Moisturising Conditioner for women to moisturise & nourish your hair along with Bodywise's Hair Strengthening Serum to strengthen your hair follicles & protect your hair.
